channel.title: VolleyStats
channel.description: Opponent-adjusted stats, team ratings, power rankings, RPI and matchup projections for NCAA D1 women's volleyball.

item.title: Week five: Tennessee and Texas A&M beat Kentucky, and Georgia falls off the bubble
item.description: The fifth weekend of league play in the seven conferences we track: 13 upsets, a Big Ten race that's Nebraska's to lose, and the biggest bubble move of the season.

item.title: Weekend preview: Nebraska visits Michigan State, and seven more to watch
item.description: Unbeaten Nebraska goes to East Lansing, Louisville hosts Georgia Tech, and three SEC matches with seeding on the line, with each team's numbers from the season so far.

item.title: Wednesday preview: Kentucky at Tennessee headlines a seven-match night
item.description: Seven Division I matches tonight, led by an SEC meeting of two top-10 teams in our power ratings, plus two rematches and a Lindenwood team that hasn't lost at home.

item.title: Week four: Florida wins twice in Texas, and the host line shuffles
item.description: The fourth weekend of league play in the seven conferences we track, and what it did to our projected NCAA tournament field: two new hosts, a tighter bubble, and an even bigger favorite.

item.title: Week three: mid-major standings and new names on the bubble
item.description: Every league outside the Power 4 after three weekends of conference play, where the standings and our projection disagree, and the teams that played their way into the NCAA tournament conversation this week.

item.title: Pick your team
item.description: Star a favorite team and the site builds itself around it: highlighted in every table, first on the Teams tab, and lined up against its next opponent in Compare.

item.title: Week two: Nebraska pulls away, and the bubble moves
item.description: The second weekend of league play in the seven conferences we track, and what it did to our projected NCAA tournament field: three new hosts, a new bubble, and a bigger favorite.

item.title: Weekend one is done. Time for Bracketology.
item.description: League play has started, so the tournament picture starts to mean something. Our first projected 64-team field, how it's built, and where the bubble sits today.

item.title: Conference openers: who's 2-0 and why
item.description: The first weekend of league play in the SEC, Big Ten, Big 12, ACC, Big East, WCC and Mountain West, and the one number that decided almost every match.

item.title: Welcome to the numbers
item.description: What this site is, where the data comes from, and how to read a 40–99 rating.
